subject: general
question: In India, __________ is observed as Rashtriya Ekta Diwas or National Unity Day every year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**31 October**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Rashtriya Ekta Diwas** or **National Unity Day** is observed in India on **31 October** every year.
 
• This day marks the birth anniversary of **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**, who was the first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of India.
 
• Sardar Patel is known as the "**Iron Man of India**" for his role in the integration of over 500 princely states into the Indian Union after independence.
 
• The day is celebrated to honor his contributions to the unity, integrity, and security of the nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**

 
 
• Sardar Patel was born on 31 October 1875 in Nadiad, Gujarat.
 
• He played a key role in India's freedom struggle and later in the integration of the princely states into India.
 
• His efforts to unify the country earned him the title "Iron Man of India".
 
• He was instrumental in the establishment of the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and the Indian Police Service (IPS).
 
 
 
• **Rashtriya Ekta Diwas**
 
 
• Rashtriya Ekta Diwas was introduced by the Government of India in 2014.
 
• The day is marked by various events, including the "**Run for Unity**," which promotes national unity and integrity.
 
• It aims to foster and reinforce the government's dedication to preserve and strengthen the unity, integrity, and security of the nation.
 
• Various programs are organized across the country to celebrate the contributions of Sardar Patel to the nation.
 
 
 
• **Statue of Unity**
 
 
• The Statue of Unity is a colossal statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel located in the state of Gujarat, India.
 
• It is the world's tallest statue, standing at a height of 182 meters (597 feet).
 
• The statue was** inaugurated on 31 October 2018 by Prime Minister Narendra Modi**.
 
• It serves as a tribute to Patel's efforts in unifying the country and stands as a symbol of national unity.
